infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Nesora uses your camera for video calls and post media creation.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Nesora uses your microphone for voice calls, video calls, and voice notes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Nesora needs access to your photos to upload media to your feed and stories.
